answer: The prism assignment is published and garden records each panel. The grading quorum of 9 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the ledge graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1984 impostors cost 196 times the honest price and take 16 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
